actions.countermeasure: Fit sealed lids on slurry holding tanks and add a viscosity check to the start-of-shift checklist.
actions.root_cause: Coating slurry viscosity drifted between batches; 5-Why: thickness out of spec -> slurry viscosity high -> solvent evaporation in open holding tank -> no tank lid / level control -> holding procedure not defined.

actions.countermeasure: Switch electrode tip changes to a weld-count trigger (every 5,000 welds) and log counts in the line system.
actions.root_cause: Weld electrode tips worn past tolerance; 5-Why: weak welds -> electrode tip wear -> no tip-change interval defined -> maintenance schedule based on calendar, not weld count.

actions.countermeasure: Add per-zone temperature alarms on the pouch sealer and a daily seal-strength pull test.
actions.root_cause: Seal bar temperature varied across the bar; 5-Why: edge leaks -> uneven seal temperature -> one heater zone failed intermittently -> heater zone has no temperature alarm.

actions.countermeasure: Add a mandatory nozzle purge step to the line-restart procedure and audit compliance weekly.
actions.root_cause: Particles introduced during electrolyte fill; 5-Why: contamination -> fill nozzle not purged after line stops -> purge step missing from restart procedure.

actions.countermeasure: Add jig locating pins to the monthly preventive-maintenance list with a go/no-go gauge check.
actions.root_cause: Stacking jig loosened over time; 5-Why: misalignment -> jig locating pins worn -> pins not on the preventive-maintenance list.

actions.countermeasure: Install a door-open timer with an audible alert after 90 seconds and add a loading time limit to the work instruction.
actions.root_cause: Formation chamber door left open during loading; 5-Why: temperature excursion -> door open too long -> loading procedure has no time limit -> no door timer or alert.
